questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) ________ seen the film before.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I really enjoyed the concert,' she said to me.
options: She said that she had really enjoyed the concert.
She said to me that she had really enjoyed the concert.
She said that she had really enjoyed the concert.
She said to me that she had really enjoyed the concert.
questions.answer: She said to me that she had really enjoyed the concert.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly reports the statement? 'I am going to the cinema tonight,' he said.
options: He said that he was going to the cinema that night.
He said that he was going to the cinema that night.
He said he was going to the cinema that night.
He said that he was going to the cinema that night.
questions.answer: He said that he was going to the cinema that night.
